subject: MSA timing & exhibit scope for Zephyr renewal — capacity uplift & execution plan
messages:
From: Claire Tesla <claire@zephyr.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zephyr.io
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + capacity uplift — PO attached / timing

Hannah —

Hope you’re well. Zephyr’s leadership reviewed usage and we want to move forward with the upcoming renewal and a 20% capacity uplift across embeddings and hosted API units. Key asks from our side:

- Confirm a 12 vs 18 month term trade (we prefer 12 but would consider 18 for a stepped discount)
- Updated MSA with any new indemnity/data-retention language you require
- Order form that reflects the uplift and monthly billing cadence
- Target signature date: Oct 21 (we’d like to avoid any lapse in service)

I’ve attached our internal PO (Zephyr_PO_2026.pdf) with the headcount and spend numbers — procurement@zephyr.io is on copy. Can you outline the path to get legal redlines turned around and the expected DocuSign route?

Thanks — looking to keep this tight.

—Claire Tesla
Director, Cloud Integrations
Zephyr Analytics


From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Claire Tesla <claire@zephyr.io>
Cc: procurement@zephyr.io, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + capacity uplift — PO attached / timing

Claire —

Thanks for the PO and the clear timing. We can meet the Oct 21 signature target if we align quickly on a couple of items. Proposed next steps from Redwood:

1) I’ll confirm the final uplift numbers with finance and return a concise renewal summary (attached) by EOD.
2) I’m looping in Markus (Legal) for the MSA redline/callouts and Monica (CS) to scope the implementation sequence and rollout dates.
3) If Zephyr prefers 12 months, we’ll need to confirm the commercial trade (discount / payment cadence). If you’re open to 18 months, we can build the stepped discount into the order form.

Can procurement confirm whether they need an invoice-first or PO-first flow? Also: do you have any new data residency or audit requirements since last year?

I’ve attached a renewal summary spreadsheet (redwood_renewal_summary_20261007.xlsx) for quick review. Markus/Monica — any flags we should surface upfront?

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: 415-555-0142

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Claire Tesla <claire@zephyr.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@zephyr.io
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + capacity uplift — MSA redline guidance

Claire / Hannah —

Thanks for the heads-up. I’ve taken an initial pass on the existing MSA and flagged the areas likely to be discussed. High-level comments below; attached is a tracked-redline doc (ZA_MSA_Redline_MK_20261008.docx) with our proposed language.

1) Term / Termination: Redwood is amenable to a 12-month term at the pricing you proposed, but we need clarity on early termination liability and how pro-rated credits are calculated. If Zephyr prefers 18 months in exchange for a discount, we can draft the stepped-pricing schedule in the order form rather than the MSA.

2) Indemnity & IP: We will not accept open-ended IP indemnities. We propose language limiting obligations to direct claims and excluding indirect/consequential damages.

3) Data retention & audit: If Zephyr requires extended audit windows or custom retention reservoirs, that will impact fulfillment timelines and potentially require a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) exhibit. Please confirm exact retention window and whether logs must be exported to a customer-managed store.

4) SLA & Credits: We can preserve the existing SLA but would like to narrow credit calculations (percent of monthly invoice) to trigger thresholds we’ve proposed in the doc.

5) Billing cadence & PO acceptance: We are flexible on invoice-first vs PO-first but need procurement to confirm the PO-number and whether invoicing should be monthly in arrears or upfront for monthly commitments.

Next steps: Claire / procurement — if you can confirm (a) term preference, (b) retention requirement, and (c) billing cadence, I’ll finalize the redline and return for your legal review within 48 hours. Hannah / Monica — I’ll coordinate a 30-min call Friday morning to walk through the redline if that helps.

—Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Tesla <claire@zephyr.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zephyr.io, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + capacity uplift — MSA redline guidance

Hannah / Markus —

Thanks for the quick turn. Procurement confirmed the PO number and monthly billing-in-arrears cadence — they prefer invoice after month close. On term: leadership’s first preference is 12 months; they’ll accept 18 months if the discount is ~12% or better.

On data retention: Zephyr requires 24 months of requestable audit logs and the ability to export raw logs to our S3 where encrypted-at-rest. If that touches additional work on your side, please call it out in the quote.

I uploaded our procurement redline and the signed PO stub (Zephyr_PO_signed_stub.pdf) and created a DocuSign envelope for the order form: https://docusign.com/ZA-OrderForm-2026 — would you route the MSA and order form via DocuSign and confirm signatory route? We’d like to get this executed by Oct 21.

Quick answers to Markus’s questions:
- Term: 12 months preferred (open to 18 for the discount callout)
- Retention: 24 months + S3 export required
- Billing cadence: monthly in arrears, invoice-first acceptable but PO is in place

Next: if Redwood can confirm the SLA credit trigger thresholds and produce a final order form with stepped pricing for the uplift, procurement will queue signatures.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Claire Tesla
Director, Cloud Integrations
Zephyr Analytics
